name: agentic-coder
description: Agentic Coder: a Claude Code-style coding agent for your terminal (terminal/) running swappable local models (models/).

scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify terminal/src/cli.jsx --outfile dist/agentic-coder && chmod 755 dist/agentic-coder
scripts.install-cli: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.agentic-coder/app ~/.local/bin && cp dist/agentic-coder ~/.agentic-coder/app/agentic-coder.new && chmod 755 ~/.agentic-coder/app/agentic-coder.new && mv -f ~/.agentic-coder/app/agentic-coder.new ~/.agentic-coder/app/agentic-coder && sed "s|__REPO__|$PWD|" terminal/app/agentic-coder-launcher.sh > ~/.local/bin/coding.new && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/coding.new && mv -f ~/.local/bin/coding.new ~/.local/bin/coding && echo "installed ~/.local/bin/coding: it rebuilds itself from $PWD when the code changes"
scripts.test:binary: bun run build && AGENTIC_BIN=$PWD/dist/agentic-coder bun test ./terminal/test/app.test.mjs ./terminal/test/app-menus.test.mjs ./terminal/test/app-start.test.mjs ./terminal/test/app-hub.test.mjs ./terminal/test/app-memory.test.mjs
